parts.text: Two tasks on your to-do list are worth more than the other eight combined.
Twenty percent of your tasks bring eighty percent of your results.
those are exactly the tasks you avoid.
So you clear the small stuff first. Emails. Messages. Little things.
And small tasks are like rabbits. They multiply, and you never catch up.
Before you start anything, ask one question:
is this in my top twenty percent, or in the bottom eighty?
Brian Tracy's rule: resist the temptation to clear up small things first.
